plainTranslation: Drive and desire flow in sync. You move at the same pace, want similar things, and rarely step on each other. Failure mode: so frictionless it can lack tension. Enjoy the ease; keep some edge.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
